title: Lavington NSW - Remediate the Network
current_summary: Planned work by an upstream network provider will replace access network hardware in Lavington, NSW. The maintenance window is Monday 3 August, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM AEST, with a single interruption of up to 3 hours expected from 9:00 AM. Affected services in Lavington may briefly lose connection. We are monitoring and will update if timings change.

updates.content:
We’re preparing for planned maintenance affecting some services in Lavington, NSW. An upstream network provider will replace access network hardware. The work window is Monday 3 August, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM AEST. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected from 9:00 AM, during which services may be offline.

If you rely on your connection, you may wish to download any needed files beforehand or use mobile data during the interruption. We’ll monitor progress and share updates if anything changes. Thank you for your patience.
